angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 586,475 km at 182.27 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.4865 +/- 0.0174 mas (same row, RUWE 0.92): 182.27 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.843 +/- 0.031 solar radii from Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-50 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158...39C/abstract): 586,475 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.892 +/- 0.08 solar masses from Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-50 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158...39C/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5400 +/- 100 K from Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-50 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158...39C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-50 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158...39C/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-50.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.537, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, WASP-50: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-50 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.12 dex, from Knudstrup et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...690A.379K/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-50 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.19792, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-50 (pscomppars): age 7 Gyr, from Knudstrup et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...690A.379K/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-50 (pscomppars): rotation period 16.3 d, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)

projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-50 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.97 km/s, from Knudstrup et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...690A.379K/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.843 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.753. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
